watches.name: Cypher Aphelion — Limited Edition Automatic
watches.description: The Cypher Aphelion. A 38mm automatic dress watch built around the Miyota 8247 — a 21-jewel Japanese caliber with a 24-hour indicator and small seconds, an architecture the industry stopped producing. We secured our final allocation: 500 movements. When they are assembled, we cannot source another. The dial is a deep-space nebula, built up in multiple print passes so the milky-way band sits behind the darkness rather than on top of it. Applied polished silver batons, double at twelve. Super-LumiNova BGW9 on the hands. Both crystals are sapphire. The caseback carries the nebula printed directly onto the crystal — not onto steel — so light passes through the artwork instead of being swallowed by metal. A small aperture reveals the balance wheel and its ruby jewel. Every piece is opened, measured and regulated by hand in our Mumbai workshop across three positions — dial up, dial down, crown down — before it is sealed. None ship at factory rate. Each watch carries its own edition number, engraved on the caseback and entered in the Cypher Registry. Once allocated, a number is never reassigned. Miyota 8247 automatic · 21 jewels · 21,600 vph · 42-hour power reserve 38mm 316L steel, 43.5mm lug-to-lug, 20mm quick-release strap Domed sapphire front · nebula-printed sapphire caseback Navy suede strap, signed butterfly deployant clasp 10 ATM (100m) water resistance Regulated in-house in three positions 500 pieces — our final allocation of a discontinued caliber 2-year international warranty · dispatch from 1 November 2026 Pre-order terms: full payment now, your edition number locked instantly, 100% refundable until dispatch.

watches.name: Cypher Legacy Bordeaux — Vintage Domed Dress Watch, Deep Red Dial
watches.description: Some reds shout. This one remembers. Bordeaux is the colour of the bottle uncorked for the occasion that mattered — deep, warm, a little serious. On the Cypher Legacy it's a curved, dished dial in rich wine red, its recessed centre brushed to a soft sunburst that shifts from oxblood in shadow to a glowing claret where the light catches it. Around the edge runs a field of hobnail guilloche — hundreds of tiny pyramids, each catching light on its own — the pattern watchmakers have used for a century on pieces that cost more than cars. The warm brick-red suede strap is a second, deeper red, chosen to complement the dial rather than match it: two reds, one wrist. THE SHAPE THEY KILLED IN 1975 Before the quartz crisis, a fine watch curved — a dished dial beneath a domed crystal, made to catch light and be touched. Then flat became cheaper, and the curve vanished from everything affordable. The Legacy brings it back: a tall, double-domed sapphire crystal that rises exactly like the plexi domes of the 1960s, bending the world softly at its edge — except this one will never scratch. MORE ACCURATE THAN A LAKH Driven by a Japanese Epson VL57 quartz movement with a true small-seconds counter at six, rated to within twenty seconds a month on the wrist. A fine mechanical watch is celebrated for holding twenty seconds a day. Same number — one per day, one per month. By the only measure that matters, this keeps better time than watches costing far more. THE DETAILS · 40 mm case · 316L surgical-grade stainless steel · ~11 mm slim profile · Tall double-domed sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating · Curved, dished dial · hobnail guilloche chapter ring · sunburst centre · azurage running-seconds counter · Applied polished indices · double baton at 12 · Screw-down coin-edge crown · deep-relief heritage caseback · 10 ATM (100 m) · Brick-red suede strap with curved fitted ends · quick-release spring bars · butterfly deployant clasp A HISTORY WORN QUIETLY On the caseback, engraved in deep relief, a tribute to the factory in Bangalore that once taught India to tell its own time. Not where the world sees it — where the wearer knows it. Every Cypher Legacy is individually numbered, Ref. CL26xxxx. No two alike.

watches.name: Lifetime Warranty For Paddock '74 Watch
watches.description: Cypher Watch Company — an Indian watchmaking house that refuses to cut corners. Where others see inventory, we see instruments. Every timepiece is individually numbered, obsessively engineered, and built for the kind of person who notices what others overlook. This is the new Indian horology.

specsRaw.Digital Activation: Linked directly to your order instantly.
specsRaw.Catastrophic Mechanical Failure: We guarantee the Seiko VK64 engine against internal manufacturing defects that prevent the watch from keeping time or functioning as intended.
specsRaw.Zero Part Fees: If the engine seizes or fails under standard wear, we will repair or swap the entire movement at zero cost for parts or labor.
specsRaw.The Consumables: Battery depletion is a natural reality of a hybrid movement. Standard battery replacements are not covered.
specsRaw.Water Ingress & Abuse: Damage resulting from operating pushers underwater, leaving the crown unscrewed, or severe blunt-force trauma (drops, high-impact crashes).
specsRaw.Battle Scars: Scratches, scuffs, or patina on the case, sapphire crystal, dial, hands, or leather. Wear them with pride—they aren't defects.
specsRaw.Pit Lane Tampering: If the case back is opened or tampered with by an unauthorized third-party jeweler, this guarantee is instantly and permanently voided. Let our certified technicians handle the engine.
specsRaw.Tied to the Driver: This guarantee is an exclusive pact between Cypher and the original purchaser. It is strictly non-transferable. Original proof of purchase is required to initiate a claim.
specsRaw.Transit: The owner is responsible for safe, standard inbound shipping to our designated service center. We will cover the return shipping once the engine is restored.
